name: nl-deductions
description: Dutch personal deductions (aftrekposten) a resident individual claims in the 2026 income tax return (aangifte inkomstenbelasting). Covers mortgage interest (hypotheekrenteaftrek), the eigenwoningforfait and the Wet Hillen deduction; the tariefsaanpassing that caps relief in the top band at 37.56%; partner alimony; specific care costs (specifieke zorgkosten) with the increase and the threshold; gifts (giftenaftrek: ordinary gifts with the 1%/EUR 60 floor and 10% ceiling, periodic gifts, the cultural uplift); weekend costs for severely disabled persons; the end of the study-cost deduction; the 2026 tax credits as pointers; who files and the 1 May deadline. Tax year 2026, with 2025 figures for returns still open. Trigger phrases: aftrekposten, hypotheekrenteaftrek, tariefsaanpassing, zorgkosten aftrek, giftenaftrek, ANBI, periodieke gift, partneralimentatie, studiekosten, persoonsgebonden aftrek.
